summary.description: Two to four sentences: what the change does and the overall verdict. No praise.

covered.description: Every changed path that was actually read in this pass.

severity.description: P1: the change is wrong (incorrect behavior, security or data loss, docs contradicting code). P2: a repository rule requires it. P3: a cost paid later.

path.description: Changed file the finding sits on, or null when it belongs to no file.

line.description: Head-side line number; must be a line listed for the path in lines.json.

start_line.description: First line of a multi-line range in the same hunk as line (see lines.json), or null.

impact.description: The concrete input or state and the wrong result.

correction.description: The smallest change that fixes it.

rule.description: Where the obligation comes from: file and section (AGENTS.md § ..., an ADR, a rubric), or the word correctness.
